I believed I grew up strong and confident. I did martial arts, my friends see me as 'one of the boys'. 

I always thought Im strong enough to defend myself if anything happens...but I wasnt prepared that night. 
He was a good friend, and I let my guard down. 
#metoo #TheTealDiary

The morning after, I woke up in my bed, in my own house. 
I remembered feeling sick, dirty, and sticky. 

I just cried. With nothing in my mind, I just cried. 
When people would talk to me, I was mad. 

#metoo
#metoomvmt
#TheTealDiary

I went on with my day like nothing happened. 
It felt like a bad hangover

It wasnt long when something triggered the memory, 
and I was forced to accept what happened that night. 

I was in the middle of a busy area,
when i broke down, shaking.
#metoo
#metoomvmt
#TheTealDiary

A friend brought me to the hospital, 
we went straight to the ER. 

My friend explained what happened to the nurse in the front desk,
and she said she doesnt know how to help me. 

"Maybe you should go to the police first" she said.

#metoo
#metoomvmt
#TheTealDiary
